blocks.title: South Mountain Reservation
blocks.html: Spanning 2,110 Olmsted-designed acres along the Watchung Mountain ridges and bordering South Orange, South Mountain Reservation is one of the most impressive natural spaces in northern New Jersey. Hiking trails, carriage roads, a dog park, a wildlife refuge, a wildflower sculpture park, scenic overlooks, and the Washington Rock Lookout Historic Site make it a destination that rewards every kind of outdoor explorer.

blocks.title: South Orange Performing Arts Center
blocks.html: Located in the heart of downtown South Orange Village, SOPAC is a cultural anchor that draws world-class performers to an intimate and accessible venue. From music and comedy to spoken word and visual art in the Herb and Milly Iris Gallery, its programming spans genres and disciplines in a way that keeps the calendar consistently worth checking.

blocks.title: Pierro Gallery
blocks.html: Founded in 1994 and housed in the beautifully renovated Baird Community Center, the Pierro Gallery is South Orange's community art destination. A non-commercial space presenting diverse established and emerging visual artists, it hosts up to seven exhibitions a year and has become both a local treasure and a regional draw.

blocks.title: Meadowland Park
blocks.html: South Orange's largest and most visited park, Meadowland covers 45 acres in the heart of the village. A duck pond, the beloved Flood Hill, tennis and basketball courts, soccer and baseball fields, and the iconic Skate House give this community green space a personality that has made it a neighborhood fixture for generations.

blocks.title: Bistro d’Azure
blocks.html: A fine dining standout on Academy Street, Bistro d'Azur brings the flavors of Southern France and the broader Mediterranean to downtown South Orange. The farm-to-table menu draws on locally sourced ingredients, the prix fixe format invites a leisurely pace, and the accolades from NJ Monthly speak for themselves.

blocks.title: Sonny’s Bagels
blocks.html: A South Orange institution since 1971, Sonny's Bagels has built its reputation on hand-rolled, old-world style bagels made with simple ingredients and real technique. House-made specialty cream cheeses and smoked fish sourced from the same suppliers as New York City's most celebrated appetizing shops round out a menu that keeps locals coming back without question.

items.q: What's the minimum age for South Orange Village weed delivery?
items.a_html: New Jersey's adult-use cannabis law is clear on this point: you must be 21 or older to place a delivery order. Age is verified during account setup, and your driver will check your ID at the door before the handoff is completed. No exceptions apply.

items.q: What kind of ID do you accept for a delivery order?
items.a_html: Any valid, government-issued photo ID qualifies. Driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports are all accepted. Out-of-state IDs are welcome. Your ID must be uploaded to your Lady L account before placing your first order, and the physical ID must be present when your driver arrives.

items.q: Is a medical cannabis card required for delivery in South Orange Village?
items.a_html: No medical card is needed. Lady L operates as an adult-use dispensary, open to any customer 21 or older. A confirmed Lady L account and a valid ID are the only requirements to get your first order going.

items.q: How much can I purchase for a South Orange Village weed delivery?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law allows us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis per transaction. That can include any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes apply to a cannabis delivery order in South Orange Village?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis purchases include a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where applicable, and a $2.50 per ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). All of these apply to delivery orders exactly as they do to in-store purchases, and every applicable charge is itemized at checkout before you confirm.
